text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган is so quick to grasp
new
techniques she starts begging for
intensive
training regimens every day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон, who has had her eye on
Mayano
Top Gun, takes this opportunity
to work with her
in my stead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She conducts her training in such a
unique way
that it soon leaves Mayano
Top Gun dissatisfied.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As a result, Хиши Амадзон warns her that,
despite
her good instincts, she's not
paying attention to
her surroundings.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her words strike a chord within Mayano
Top Gun,
who hates losing. She slowly,
but surely, begins to
get the hang of the
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
